## Type of Change
- [ ] `feat`: New feature
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `refactor`: Code refactoring without behavior change
- [ ] `perf`: Performance improvement
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation update
- [ ] `chore`: Maintenance or build changes

## Checklist
- [ ] My commit messages follow the [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) specification.
- [ ] I have verified that **NO secrets, API keys, credentials, or private .ovpn files** are staged or committed.
- [ ] All automated tests (`pytest`, `npm run build`, `docker compose config`) pass locally.
- [ ] I have updated documentation or `.env.example` where applicable.
